name: Melville Castle
niche_feature: Guests stay in the 33 bedrooms and suites of the castle itself, a Gothic castle-style mansion of 1786-91 (the medieval tower castle on the site was demolished in 1780), in a 54-acre estate.
evidence_quote: Each of the castle's 33 bedrooms and suites are unique – many have four-poster beds and all have been dramatically revamped.
reason: Rooms are in the castle building; it is a late-18th-century Gothic castellated mansion rather than a medieval keep, but is the castle itself.
page_issues: Present castle is an 18th-century Gothic mansion (Wikipedia calls it a mansion), not medieval; page says 'three-storey Gothic castle'
'Rooms beneath the turrets' not found on the official homepage (unverified)
Mary Queen of Scots visits are the hotel's own marketing claim

name: Otterburn Castle Country House Hotel
niche_feature: Could not confirm. Official site returns 'Private Site' (HTTP 401). Heritage record: castellated country house rebuilt in 1830, 'site of 13th century pele tower'; surviving medieval fabric disputed between sources.
evidence_quote: Country house, now a hotel, and site of 13th century pele tower.
reason: Official site inaccessible; sources describe a castellated 1830 country house on a pele-tower site with conflicting evidence of surviving castle fabric and a past sale listing.
page_issues: Present building is an 1830 castellated country house; Northumberland HER says 'No remains of the Peel can be seen' while Wikipedia says part of the old castle walls survive
'Norman stronghold founded in 1086' refers to the site's earlier castle, not the building guests sleep in
Official website not accessible and trading status could not be confirmed; hotel was reported marketed for sale (undated)

name: Peckforton Castle
niche_feature: The 48 bedrooms and suites (including Tower Suites) are in the Grade I Victorian castle of 1851; The Lodge and The Retreat are separate group-accommodation houses on the estate.
evidence_quote: Peckforton Castle is an authentic Victorian castle built in 1851 to recreate a medieval fortress.
reason: Genuine Victorian castle with towers and battlements; guest bedrooms are in the castle, with separate lodge/retreat houses for groups.
page_issues: 'Only intact medieval-style castle in England' is the owner's own claim (page attributes it)
Page description says 48 bedrooms 'inside and around' the castle; official site lists 48 bedrooms plus separate Lodge and Retreat group houses

name: Real Castello
niche_feature: Six rooms (2 suites, 3 junior suites, 1 double) on the upper floors of the Verduno castle wing; other rooms are in the adjacent Castalderia and Nando Foresteria annexes.
evidence_quote: ai piani superiori 6 camere, tra le quali 2 Suite, 3 Junior Suite ed una camera doppia.
reason: Genuine castle wing with six guest rooms; the remaining rooms are in annexes.

name: Scargill Castle
niche_feature: One self-catering unit for two inside the restored 1550 Tudor castle (surviving three-storey gatehouse) with its own courtyard garden; the whole bookable property is the castle.
evidence_quote: Built in 1550 on the site of an earlier medieval castle, it has recently been restored from a crumbling ruin into a delightful retreat for two
reason: Scheduled-monument castle restored as a single self-catering unit; guests sleep in the castle.
page_issues: Self-catering for two, not a hotel; official site header gives 'North Yorkshire' (historic county) while page says County Durham

name: Schloss Hotel Korb
niche_feature: Castle suites (about 40 m2, most in the historic Wohnturm/castle) and some comfort doubles are in the castle; panorama suites, exclusive doubles, South Tyrolean and garden suites are in the newer Residence.
evidence_quote: Circa 40 m2 | für bis zu vier Personen | in allen Stockwerken im Schloss und Wohnturm
reason: Genuine castle with historic castle suites, but several room types are in the modern residence building.

name: Schloss Hotel Wehrburg
niche_feature: All 20 rooms (3 single, 17 double) are inside the medieval castle, in the two 18 m towers and the palas; seasonal opening, 2026 season ended 25 October, 2027 opens 15 April.
evidence_quote: unsere Einzel- und Doppelzimmer sowohl in den Türmen der Wehrburg,als auch im Palas des Schlosses.
reason: Every guest room is within the genuine medieval castle (towers and palas).

name: Star Castle Hotel
niche_feature: Castle Rooms, Superior Castle Rooms, a single and three Guard Rooms on the ramparts are in the 1593 Grade I fortress; Garden Rooms and Suites are separate newer cottage-style rooms in the grounds.
reason: Genuine Elizabethan star fort (Grade I) with castle rooms; garden rooms are separate. Official site blocked curl (403), read via WebFetch.
page_issues: Room split between castle and garden rooms not given by the official site, so the castle-room count cannot be confirmed

name: Stonefield Castle
niche_feature: Hotel in the 1837 Scottish baronial castle-style mansion by Playfair; official page gives 38 en-suite bedrooms but does not itemise which wing each is in.
evidence_quote: a fine example of Scottish baronial architecture
reason: Hotel occupies the baronial 'castle' house itself; Victorian castle-style rather than medieval. Site is behind Cloudflare, read via WebFetch.
page_issues: Official page states 38 bedrooms; the .md page gives no room count
Not a medieval fortress (page itself says Victorian baronial house)

name: The Castle Hotel
niche_feature: Not a castle keep: a late-18th-century crenellated hotel (upper floor added in the 20th century) on the castle's outer ward, incorporating Castle Bow, the 13th-century east gate. Guests sleep in the hotel, not the medieval castle.
reason: Listing dates the hotel front to late C18 with a crenellated wing; only the Castle Bow gate is medieval. Not a genuine castle stay.
page_issues: '18th-century reconstruction of Taunton's Norman castle' overstates it: the listing says main front is probably late C18 with a crenellated wing
Hotel's own history page narrates the Norman castle's keep as 'The Castle's' history although the keep is no longer part of the hotel

name: Torrisdale Castle Estate
niche_feature: Only The Servants' Quarters (sleeps 6, three bedrooms) is in the Gothic castle of 1815; the two cottages and two eco-bothies elsewhere on the estate are not in the castle.
evidence_quote: The Servants’ Quarters is located on the ground floor of the Castle
reason: Castle is genuine (1815 Scottish Gothic) but only one of five self-catering units is inside it.

name: Tulloch Castle Hotel
niche_feature: Hotel operating as Tulloch Castle with 22 en-suite bedrooms; castle with restored original fireplaces, ceilings and panelled Great Hall. Official page does not state which wing each bedroom is in. Site is behind Cloudflare, read via WebFetch.
evidence_quote: Tulloch Castle dates from the 12th century, when the Bains and later the Clan Davidson laid claim to its lands.
reason: The hotel is the historic castle itself (Wikipedia: Highland castle, late 14th century origin, extended 1891).
page_issues: 12th-century date is the hotel's claim; Wikipedia says the castle 'likely dates to at least the late 14th century'
Present building was damaged by fire in 1845 and extended in 1891
